text:
Iris (Growth): Quick experiment proposal for next webinar: combine launch posts + post-reg activation nudges. We'll test two credit sizes + three onboarding prompt bundles. Primary KPI: increase first-7d API calls from regs by 20%.

Ben (Product Marketing): outline? I want concrete arms so creative can be baked into the landing + post-reg email.

Iris (Growth): plan: randomize at RSVP completion into 6 arms (2 credit tiers x 3 prompt bundles). Credit tiers: NONE vs 60 credits. Prompt bundles: baseline (generic quickstarts), verticalized (support/search/docs), hands-on (step-by-step template + checklist).

Asha (Content): creative asks: 6 short post-reg email variants + 3 social ad captions. Can we keep email subject to ~5 words?

Kofi (Data): tracking: window 7 days. Events: `webinar_registered`,`email_sent_variant`,`prompt_bundle_assigned`,`credit_amount`,`first_api_call`,`demo_interest_click`. I'll add cohort labels `exp_arm` with strings like "60_vertical".

Ben (Product Marketing): for benchmark narrative we should include a quick stat in the social copy: "Ship a docs assistant with <100 tokens per query" — need to craft that so it doesn't leak sensitive metrics.

Iris (Growth): good. Also testing routing: subset of regs that redeem credits get immediate nurture email w/ quickstart; others follow standard drip. We'll measure routing interaction.

Asha (Content): email copy drafts (ultra-short):
- baseline/no-credit: "You're in — try our prompt quickstarts."
- baseline/+60: "Welcome — 60 credits + quickstarts inside."
- vertical/+60: "Welcome — 60 credits + templates for <vertical>."
- hands-on/+60: "Kickoff guide + 60 credits — build in 30 minutes."

Kofi (Data): can we tag `utm_experiment` on the landing links so we can attribute social creative -> arm?

Iris (Growth): yes, add UTM param and add to HubSpot mapping. routing-bot: will add `exp_arm` to contact properties.

routing-bot: HubSpot property created: `exp_arm` (enum). Mapping queued.

amp-bot: Amplitude schema update: added events [`email_sent_variant`,`prompt_bundle_assigned`,`credit_amount`,`first_api_call`]. Link: https://amplitude.company/schemas/1765439999-exp

Ben (Product Marketing): timeline: creative by Wed noon, tracking signoff Wed EOD, dry-run Thurs morning, full launch Fri. Post-launch check at 7 days.

Asha (Content): I'll post the 3 social captions + 6 email bodies to #marketing-assets. Need examples of each vertical for the landing quickstarts (support, search, docs).

Kofi (Data): I'll create a dashboard tile comparing arms on registration -> activation funnel and a cost-per-activation calc assuming credit redemption rate.

Iris (Growth): owners: Asha = copy & assets, Ben = benchmark narrative + social targeting, Kofi = tracking + dashboard, routing-bot = HubSpot mapping. Sync Thurs 9am for dry-run check.

Ben (Product Marketing): small ask — can the hands-on bundle include an inline 3-step tutorial so folks can get a quick win in the app? Asha will author.

Asha (Content): yep, will draft the 3-step and a downloadable checklist for the hands-on pack.
